description: This file is a demo PHP script that creates and configures an instance of the Smarty templating engine, assigns variables to be used in a template, and then displays a specified template. It illustrates usage of the Smarty class, variable assignments, and template rendering.

classes.name: Smarty
classes.description: Main class of the Smarty templating engine that manages template rendering, variable assignment, and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the Smarty class, initializes the Smarty object.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the Smarty template environment.
